title: The Gramophone Pin Mystery
subtitle: A Curious Clue and a Deadly Puzzle
summary: When an innocuous newspaper advertisement catches Byomkesh Bakshi’s sharp eye, a seemingly ordinary morning swiftly unravels into an intriguing investigation. As hidden messages and curious coincidences come to light, follow the legendary detective and his companion as they untangle a web of secrets where even the smallest clue could be deadly. Dive in and see if you can solve the mystery before Byomkesh does.
